name: Gaffe Ring, Greater
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As the gaffe ring, but the penalty is -10 to all Diplomacy checks.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse, followed by eagle’s splendor, upon it, rendering it non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items diplomat’s ring, greater

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
